subject: history
title: Ashoka's 14 Major Rock Edicts
description: Complete list of Ashoka's 14 Major Rock Edicts with their contents

content.overview: Emperor Ashoka (268-232 BCE) inscribed 14 Major Rock Edicts across his empire to spread the message of Dhamma. They were deciphered by James Prinsep in 1837.
keyPoints: Edict 1: Prohibition of animal sacrifices and festive gatherings
Edict 2: Measures of social welfare (medical care, planting of trees, wells, rest houses)
Edict 3: Respect to Brahmanas; courtesy to relatives and elders; consideration for animals
Edict 4: Courtesy to relatives, elders, consideration for animals
Edict 5: Appointment of Dhamma Mahamatras and their duties
Edict 6: Need for efficient organisation of administration (orders to Dhamma Mahamatras)
Edict 7: Need for tolerance among all religious sects
Edict 8: System of Dhamma-yatras (tours for spreading Dhamma)
Edict 9: Attack on meaningless ceremonies and rituals
Edict 10: Conquest through Dhamma instead of war
Edict 12: Appeal for tolerance among all religious sects
Edict 13: Kalinga War; mention of 5 contemporary Hellenic (Greek) kings — Antiochus II, Ptolemy II, Antigonus, Magas, Alexander
Edict 14: Inspiration to spend religious life

mnemonics.trick: 2-5-7-12-13 = Welfare, Dhamma Mahamatras, Tolerance, Tolerance, Kalinga War
mnemonics.explanation: Edict 2 (social welfare), Edict 5 (Dhamma Mahamatras), Edict 7 & 12 (religious tolerance), Edict 13 (Kalinga War & Greek kings) — most asked in exams

mnemonics.trick: A-P-A-M-A = Antiochus II (Syria), Ptolemy II (Egypt), Antigonus (Macedonia), Magas (Cyrene), Alexander (Epirus)
mnemonics.explanation: Edict 13 mentions 5 Hellenic kings: Antiochus II Theos, Ptolemy II Philadelphus, Antigonus Gonatas, Magas, Alexander

mnemonics.trick: 13th Edict = 13 = 'B' for Bad (war) — after Kalinga War, Ashoka gave up war
mnemonics.explanation: The 13th Rock Edict describes the Kalinga War (261 BCE) and Ashoka's remorse, after which he adopted Dhamma-vijaya (conquest by righteousness)

quiz.question: Which Ashokan edict describes the Kalinga War?
quiz.explanation: The 13th Major Rock Edict describes the Kalinga War (261 BCE) and mentions 5 Greek kings

quiz.question: Dhamma Mahamatras were appointed under which edict?
quiz.explanation: Edict 5 deals with the appointment of Dhamma Mahamatras and their duties

quiz.question: Ashoka's edicts were deciphered by:
quiz.explanation: James Prinsep deciphered the Brahmi script of Ashokan edicts in 1837

quiz.question: Edict 13 mentions how many contemporary Greek kings?
quiz.explanation: Edict 13 mentions 5 Hellenic kings: Antiochus II, Ptolemy II, Antigonus, Magas, and Alexander

timeline.event: Ashokan edicts deciphered by James Prinsep
